highlights.title: This Mac is always there
highlights.line: Mewla for Mac always has this Mac. Nothing to pair, and it comes back by itself.

highlights.title: Pick each agent's model
highlights.line: Tap the model beside Send in a Session to pick another model.

fixes: The terminal opens on the Mac whichever computer the Session is on.
Mewla cleans up what ended Sessions leave behind.
A pairing code someone else got hold of can no longer stand in for your computer.
